# 196 RESULT - Replication R-01 (yeast GCN vs FBA, mega27-05 @ 4b66f67)
Prereg: algo50/196-PREREG.md (committed 03:24 IST before any repo code was run; text sha256 5422b7a3e54493846d2cf870c0167eb748895c561b446269eafb076fdf5b075f, trailing newline aside). Run once, nothing altered after seeing results. This is a same-organisation re-execution, not an independent reimplementation, and not a novel method.

## Verdict by preregistered mapping: REPLICATED
- A (exact seed 20260924): gcn - fba AUC delta +0.13469, CI95 [0.11408, 0.15493]. Criterion |delta - 0.1347| <= 0.02 and CI lower > 0: PASS. (Repo-committed: 0.13469, [0.11438, 0.15499]. Mean AUC fba 0.6967, gcn 0.8314.)
- B (fresh seed 196196): delta +0.12112, CI95 [0.10083, 0.14285]. Criterion mean >= 0.10 and CI lower > 0: PASS. (fba 0.6959, gcn 0.8170.)
- C (feature-matched control, seed 196196): gcn - logreg delta +0.03743, CI95 [0.01874, 0.05693]. Criterion CI lower > 0: PASS. logreg mean AUC 0.7796.

## Wording consequence
The claim stands: the GCN ranks essential genes better than the FBA rule. Most of the gap (about +0.084 of +0.121 on fresh seeds) comes from using the 11 structural/flux features, not graph learning; the graph adds a smaller but CI-positive +0.037 over logistic regression on the same features. Claim should be worded accordingly: "feature-based models beat the single-column FBA rule; the GCN adds about +0.04 AUC beyond a linear model".

## Caveats
Same data, same organisation, same code (unmodified, called through a driver equal to the repo's run_cv minus CNN/ensemble). Reproduction confirms the computation, not the external validity of the labels. Bootstrap is over 15 fold deltas that share data across repeats, so CIs are somewhat optimistic. Only claim #1 is covered.
